review: The primary reader personally inspected the whole image, both halves, all eight broad line-block crops at 3×, and individual doubtful, cancelled and differing details at 5× (the first opaque cancellation at 7×). The directed limits, primes and indices, equivalences, arrows, brackets, insertion guides, underlining and all words were compared with both witnesses. Wider 5× crops corrected several initially too-narrow detail windows. The prose remains surprising where the visible ink is surprising. No context was opened.
